mapper.sql: L.SEQ as seq, L.PARTICIPANT_SEQ as participantSeq, L.ACTION_TYPE_SEQ as actionTypeSeq, L.ACTION_TIME as actionTime, L.DEVICE_INFO as deviceInfo, L.CONFIRMED_BY as confirmedBy, L.MEMO as memo
, T.ACTION_CODE as actionCode, T.ACTION_NAME as actionName, U.USER_NAME as userName, P.DEPARTMENT as department, P.POSITION as position
mapper.select: SELECT , T.ACTION_CODE as actionCode, T.ACTION_NAME as actionName FROM EVENT_ACTION_LOG L INNER JOIN EVENT_ACTION_TYPE T ON L.ACTION_TYPE_SEQ = T.SEQ WHERE L.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = #{participantSeq} ORDER BY L.ACTION_TIME DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_ACTION_LOG L INNER JOIN EVENT_PARTICIPANT P ON L.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = P.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq}

SELECT T.SEQ as actionTypeSeq, T.ACTION_CODE as actionCode, T.ACTION_NAME as actionName, T.REQUIRE_ADMIN_AUTH as requireAdminAuth, T.ALLOW_MULTIPLE as allowMultiple, CASE WHEN L.SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as completed, L.ACTION_TIME as completedAt, L.CONFIRMED_BY as confirmedBy FROM EVENT_ACTION_TYPE T LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM EVENT_ACTION_LOG WHERE PARTICIPANT_SEQ = #{participantSeq} ) L ON T.SEQ = L.ACTION_TYPE_SEQ WHERE T.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT T.SEQ as actionTypeSeq, T.ACTION_CODE as actionCode, T.ACTION_NAME as actionName, COUNT(DISTINCT L.PARTICIPANT_SEQ) as completedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_PARTICIPANT WHERE EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq}) as totalCount FROM EVENT_ACTION_TYPE T LEFT JOIN EVENT_ACTION_LOG L ON T.SEQ = L.ACTION_TYPE_SEQ WHERE T.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY T.SEQ, T.ACTION_CODE, T.ACTION_NAME ORDER BY T.SORT_ORDER ASC
